data.case_title: Company pension offer (Entgeltumwandlung) from Beispiel Logistik Süd GmbH
data.title: Company pension offer (Entgeltumwandlung) from Beispiel Logistik Süd GmbH
data.summary: Beispiel Logistik Süd GmbH offers employee Anton Musterschmidt the option to convert part of his gross salary into a company pension (Direktversicherung) starting 1 July 2027, with the employer adding a 15% top-up to the converted amount, and asks for his decision within 10 working days of the letter's date.
data.explanation: This letter offers you a salary-sacrifice pension scheme (betriebliche Altersversorgung / Entgeltumwandlung): you can choose to have part of your gross salary paid into a company pension insurance (Direktversicherung) starting 1 July 2027, and your employer adds 15% on top of whatever you convert. Joining is optional — if you don't want to participate, a short message to HR is enough. You must tell HR your decision by the deadline shown (counted in working days from the letter's date, excluding public holidays). Review the enclosed offer and premium calculation carefully before deciding, since it affects your net pay, taxes and future pension; consulting HR or an independent advisor can help if you're unsure.
data.tax_note: Salary converted into a company pension (Entgeltumwandlung) reduces taxable gross income and is relevant for payroll tax and social security calculations; keep this offer letter with your payslips.

key_facts.label: Start date of pension plan
key_facts.quote: ab dem 01.07.2027 können Sie einen Teil Ihres Bruttogehalts in eine Direktversicherung einzahlen.

key_facts.label: Employer top-up (Arbeitgeberzuschuss)
key_facts.quote: Wir legen 15 % des umgewandelten Betrags als Arbeitgeberzuschuss dazu.

key_facts.label: Reply deadline
key_facts.quote: Teilen Sie uns Ihre Entscheidung bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum mit.

items.title: Tell HR your decision on the company pension offer
